# Las Cruces Cash Home Buyers

> Local cash home buyer serving Las Cruces, NM and the surrounding
> Mesilla Valley in Dona Ana County (plus parts of Sierra and Otero
> counties). We buy single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and
> small multifamily for cash, close in 7-30 days, and pay all
> closing costs. No agent commissions, no repair credits, no
> contingencies. Locally operated, funded with our own capital.

## Service area

Mesilla Valley — Dona Ana County primary, plus surrounding Sierra
and Otero counties. Primary cities:

- Las Cruces (88001-88012)
- Mesilla
- Sunland Park
- Anthony (NM side)
- Dona Ana
- Chaparral
- Hatch

Other communities: Mesilla Park, San Miguel, La Mesa, Vado, Berino,
Mesquite, Garfield, Rincon, Salem, Radium Springs, Picacho Hills,
Organ.

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- Las Cruces Cash Home Buyers pays all closing costs
- We use our own capital — no financing or appraisal contingencies
- Closing at a Dona Ana County title company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (New Mexico is a judicial foreclosure state;
  Dona Ana County District Court handles cases; typical timeline
  6-9 months; we close before sheriff's sale)
- Inherited / probate houses (NM probate; Dona Ana County Probate
  Court; informal probate typically 4-6 months)
- Divorce sales (NM is community property; both parties cash out
  same date)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire damage, monsoon damage,
  foundation issues from valley clay soils, code violations,
  hoarding, long-vacant)
- NMSU faculty/staff relocations
- White Sands Test Facility / Holloman AFB military moves
- Memorial Medical Center physician transfers
- Border-region cross-jurisdiction situations
- Out-of-state inheritances (entire transaction handled remotely)
- Tired landlords and investor exits

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a
60-90 day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors — a
traditional listing will typically net more after costs.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are
a professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
